official.deadline_note: Published on AGCID's Ofertas Vigentes page as 'Plazo Final de Postulación (Consultar con el Punto Focal la fecha límite de entrega de antecedentes)': 30-10-2026. National focal points may set earlier document deadlines.
official.status_note: AGCID's Ofertas Vigentes page lists 'Programa de Becas de Cooperación Sur Sur-Republica de Chile 2027' with final application deadline 30-10-2026; the convocatoria PDF is dated May 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Clause C-I of the convocatoria: payment of the arancel, matrícula and titulación costs charged by the institution, capped at four academic semesters or six trimesters.
benefits: Monthly maintenance allowance of six hundred thousand Chilean pesos (CLP 600.000) paid for the duration of the programme, up to 24 months
One-off allowance of ninety thousand Chilean pesos (CLP 90.000) for texts and study materials in the first term
One-off thesis-support allowance of three hundred thousand Chilean pesos (CLP 300.000), paid if the scholar's grade average is 5.5 or higher on the Chilean scale
Life, health and accident insurance while the scholarship is in force, plus access to Chilean public primary health care
Payment of arancel, matrícula and titulación costs (capped at 4 semesters / 6 trimesters)
eligibility: Nationals of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Panama, Dominican Republic and the CARICOM member countries
Degree-holding professionals working in government programmes, ministries or public services
Academic staff, teachers or researchers of universities officially recognised by their countries
Professionals working in the various areas of civil society of the invited countries
Unconditional acceptance from a participating Chilean institution on a master's programme listed in Annex 1
Spouses of other AGCID scholarship holders are not accepted; scholarships are incompatible with any other held in Chile
requirements: Apply through your country's PUNTO FOCAL with a copy to the Chilean embassy (confirm the focal point's document deadline)
Hold unconditional acceptance from the Chilean institution - securing admission, and its costs, is the applicant's responsibility
Apply only to a master's programme listed in Annex 1 of the call
Full-time (dedicación exclusiva) study in person in Chile
documents: Definitive acceptance letter with the programme start and end dates, including the degree examination
Original professional degree certificate or a copy authorised by a public notary
Motivation letter with the reasons for studying in Chile
Brief description of the possible thesis area
Sponsorship letter from the employing institution (respaldo institucional)
Health certificate issued by a licensed physician with signature and stamp (Annex 5)
Official document from the embassy of the applicant's country certifying command of Spanish, where the country requires it
Word document with information about the master's programme and the applicant
selection_criteria: Priority to applications from public officials or academics of universities recognised by the applicant's country
Applications within the Annex 1 master's programmes

Priority to postgraduate programmes in thematic areas Chile considers relevant to human-capital development (astronomy, mining, Antarctic sciences, renewable energies, marine resources, economic development and others listed in the call)
Results generally published in the second fortnight of December
coverage: Arancel, matrícula and titulación costs, capped at four academic semesters or six trimesters
Monthly maintenance allowance of CLP 600.000, capped at 24 months
Life, health and accident insurance; access to Chilean public primary health care once the applicant holds a Chilean national identity card
One-off CLP 90.000 texts and materials allowance; one-off CLP 300.000 thesis-support allowance (grade average 5.5 or above)
Benefits II, III and IV do not apply to scholars on virtual programmes
AGCID pays no other expense: visa procedures, application costs to Chilean institutions, airport and similar taxes, and trips home during the fellowship are the scholar's responsibility
application_method: Send the application electronically to the national PUNTO FOCAL of your country (Annex 3) with an electronic copy to the Chilean embassy
Secure unconditional admission to the Annex 1 master's programme before applying
official.application_route: Submit the complete electronic file to your country's PUNTO FOCAL with a copy to the Chilean embassy, holding unconditional admission to an Annex 1 master's programme.
official.study_mode: Full-time (dedicación exclusiva), in person in Chile
official.citizenship_residency: Nationals of the invited Latin American and Caribbean countries listed in the call
official.international_eligibility: Only nationals of the invited Latin American and CARICOM countries listed in the call
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Master's programmes listed in Annex 1 of the call, with priority thematic areas (astronomy, mining, Antarctic sciences, renewable energies, marine resources, economic development, among others)
official.research_requirement: A brief description of the possible thesis area must accompany the application; the thesis-support allowance requires an approved thesis project and a grade average of 5.5 or above
official.duration: Up to a maximum of 24 months; studies start between 1 March and 30 September 2027 (programme dates published as 03-03-2027 to 28-02-2029)
official.description: AGCID, Chile's international cooperation agency, offers South-South cooperation scholarships for Latin American and Caribbean professionals to study accredited master's programmes at Chilean higher-education institutions, contributing to advanced human-capital formation for the academic year 2027.

verification.notes: AGCID's Ofertas Vigentes page was rendered in a browser (the list loads inside an iframe) and shows the call with the 30-10-2026 final deadline; the official convocatoria PDF for República de Chile 2027 was downloaded and read in full, confirming the CLP 600.000 monthly allowance, the CLP 90.000 texts and CLP 300.000 thesis-support one-offs, the 24-month cap, the tuition cap of 4 semesters/6 trimesters, insurance, the invited-country list, the Annex 1 restriction and the expense exclusions. The FAQ page confirms the same benefit structure. No English proficiency requirement is published; a Spanish certificate from the applicant's embassy is required only where the country calls for it.

applicant_utility.summary: Admission comes before the scholarship: you must already hold unconditional acceptance to an Annex 1 master's programme at a Chilean institution, and the admission process and its costs are entirely on you, so start university admissions months before the October deadline. Applications travel through your country's PUNTO FOCAL - not to AGCID directly - and focal points can close their intake earlier than 30 October, so confirm their date first. Financially the CLP 600.000 monthly allowance plus tuition, insurance and the two one-off payments cover the programme itself, but airfare, visas and trips home are explicitly yours to fund.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career public-sector professionals, university academics or civil-society staff from an invited Latin American or Caribbean country with unconditional admission to an accredited Chilean master's programme.
application_readiness_checklist: Contact your country's PUNTO FOCAL (Annex 3) immediately and confirm its document deadline - it can precede 30 October 2026
Secure unconditional acceptance from a Chilean programme on Annex 1, in writing, with start and end dates

Assemble the file: acceptance letter, notarised degree certificate, CV, motivation letter, thesis-area description, employer sponsorship letter, academic reference, health certificate, embassy Spanish certificate if required, Word info sheet, passport copy
Send the electronic file to the focal point with a copy to the Chilean embassy
Check that your proposed master's sits in one of the priority thematic areas (astronomy, mining, Antarctic sciences, renewable energies, marine resources, economic development)
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a master's programme not listed in Annex 1 - such applications are not considered
Missing unconditional admission by the application date, or leaving admission costs unbudgeted
Missing your national focal point's earlier deadline and assuming the 30 October international date applies
Both spouses applying in the same round - only one can receive the scholarship
Holding or applying for another scholarship in Chile, which is incompatible
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Visa procedures, application fees to Chilean institutions, airport and similar taxes, trips or transfers to your home country during the fellowship, and travel insurance for the flights to and from Chile - the convocatoria states AGCID pays none of these.
document_audit: The acceptance letter must be definitive and unconditional, with the programme start and end dates and the degree examination
The degree certificate must be original or notarised - a plain scan can stall the file
The health certificate needs a licensed physician's signature and stamp on Annex 5
alerts: Leaving Chile in December, January or February requires individual AGCID authorisation, and without it you lose 100% of that month's allowance - apply well in advance
The CLP 300.000 thesis payment requires a 5.5+ average and must be requested before the nineteenth monthly payment, with the thesis timetable, project approval and grade certificate
Results usually appear in the second fortnight of December, for a 2027 academic year - bridge your finances accordingly
Volunteering for a virtual programme forfeits the allowance, insurance and materials benefits
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure admission at an Annex 1 Chilean programme, send the electronic file to your national PUNTO FOCAL with a copy to the Chilean embassy by their deadline (final 30/10/2026); AGCID publishes results, generally in the second fortnight of December.
